notes: binder holds bind on roles, so it can bind itself to any Role (SOD-SELF-GRANT). ops-agent patches Deployments and deletes Events, the in-cluster record of what happened (SOD-ACT-ERASE-AUDIT). deployer's wildcard rule names no specific operation, and creating RoleBindings without bind cannot grant more than it holds, so deployer has no conflict.
